//: Reviewed, intentional differences from compat/baseline.json that must not fail `npm run check:compat`. Friction on purpose: every entry needs an id (copy it from the failure output), a reason a reviewer can check, and the version that introduces it. Prefer deprecating and keeping the old API; only genuinely compatible-in-practice changes or deliberate (major) breaks belong here. Entries that stop matching anything are reported so they get removed (they become obsolete once the baseline is regenerated at release time).

allowed.reason: Issue #60: TimelineProps became generic, TimelineProps<E extends TimelineItem = TimelineEvent> { events: E[] }, so Timeline also accepts the new, wider TimelineItem (optional time, ReactNode description, 'neutral' status). Only the declaration text changed: with the default type argument a bare TimelineProps still has events: TimelineEvent[], so code that reads props.events[i].time / .description / .status keeps the same types, and TimelineEvent itself is unchanged. Existing <Timeline events={...} /> calls with TimelineEvent[] or inline literals still compile (pinned in Timeline.test.tsx).
